action_schema: same seventh PriceBasis native schema plus metadata; 13 cash including 2014 warmup, 1 split
blocks_apply_to: all simulated buys/sells on specified dates; actual close remains valuation input if present
block_2022_01_14_reason: unverified first-resumption exchange limit reference; research approximation, not an actual suspension
open_fill_inputs: current opening price plus prior available close/action reference and dated restrictions; high low close unavailable at open
volume_usage: ratios within one product only; no absolute turnover/volume based sizing
same_day_resale_research_policy: do not sell shares bought the same day in any product; stricter than some legal permissions, must be fixed in account protocol
missing_quote_policy: retain dated absence and any cash/actions; no synthetic fill; carry stale mark with age, split-adjust units if effective
scope: conditional daily-price approximation; not certified all-event/exchange calendar coverage
root_authorized_block_note: parent accepted Jan14 conservative block before candidate results
